what: Draws an alpha-video character on a canvas: it repeats the default clip (input) for over 17 seconds, then plays one of the stored idle clips (rhythm, stretch) once and returns to default. Where the character is painted (alpha > 10) Only over it does it become a hand cursor (checked every 100ms) and fire fx:hover/fx:leave, on press (Enter · Space) it plays the press clip (look-back) once and fires fx:open when passing its 50% — that event opens the about drawer. The press clip stops on its last frame.

options.idles: Idle clip URLs (comma-separated) — one picked at random from those preloaded after the default clip has played past idle-after
options.click: Press clip URL — not pressable if empty
options.still: Instead of the default clip, two still images (night, sleeping) — if given, it shows these without looping, then switches to the press clip
options.idle-after: Time until the rest clip plays (ms), default 17000
options.alpha: Alpha threshold counted as picture (0~255), default 10
options.open-at: At what fraction of the press clip fx:open fires, default .5
options.fx:hover · fx:leave · fx:pick · fx:open: Events fired from the canvas — used for toggling the follower circle, press start, and opening the drawer

note: A video opened over file:// can’t have its canvas read, so then the whole panel is shown as an image (over http it is masked by alpha). The original clip is a 1440 square alpha webm (mov for Safari)
use: <canvas data-fx="alpha-clip-canvas" data-fx-alpha-clip-canvas="loop: media/typing.webm; idles: media/rhythm.webm, media/stretching.webm; click: media/click-pose.webm" role="button" aria-label="Talk to the character" style="height:100vh"></canvas>

from.where: index.js home [data-character-canvas] (original jh(): plays typing with preload auto, and each time it ends, if within 17000ms it plays typing again, if over it picks randomly among the already downloaded rhythm·stretching, alpha test via getImageData > 10 · pointermove 100ms, on press switches to click-pose, pauses the room video and hides the sleep icon, opens the drawer at currentTime/duration ≥ .5, restarts paused clips every 500ms, night uses character_sleep.png + night_click-pose)
from.options: loop: media/typing.webm; idles: media/rhythm.webm, media/stretching.webm; click: media/click-pose.webm
